logging.masking: Mask all secrets, tokens, and PII before emitting outputs or storing logs.
logging.audit: Maintain structured audit logs with timestamps, slice identifiers, and validation results under ${ARTIFACT_ROOT}/logs/.

success_criteria: Zero secrets or PII present in logs

ARTIFACT_ROOT.notes: Root directory for all Guard Phase artifacts.

ENABLE_CI_VALIDATION.description: Scaffolded toggle for enabling CI validation routines.

critic_check.coverage: Review pytest + coverage results to confirm ≥70% coverage.
critic_check.typing: Ensure mypy passes with ≥95% type coverage.
critic_check.formatting: Confirm ruff and black report no issues and pre-commit hooks succeed.

requirements: Verify log sanitizer stripped secrets before artifact storage.
Ensure security audit report exists at ${ARTIFACT_ROOT}/logs/security_audit_<timestamp>.log.
Document findings in structured audit trail with masked tokens.
